data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): Dedup-scope clarification — the dedup in this task is INTRA-snapshot (same jira_key appearing in overlapping page ranges from ACLI mid-fetch). It is NOT cross-pass mutation dedup. The story description's 'Per-issue mutation dedup in differ' refers to the structural invariant that the snapshot dict the differ consumes has each key at most once — that invariant is enforced HERE at the fetcher and reaches differ.py without code change to differ.py. Cross-pass mutation dedup, if needed, is OUT OF SCOPE for this story (sibling cde1-30ba owns canonical manifest).
